name: Bridgeport-type turret knee mill
model: Bridgeport-type turret knee mill (9 x 42 in table)
description: Manual vertical knee mill with a ram-and-turret head, quill feed and a 9 x 42 in table, for simple features and one-offs.
license: GrabCAD community model by cheng chia (2020), GrabCAD terms of use; not self-made or CC0
notes: No Bridgeport or Acer model with an assembled STEP turned up (the Bridgeport-type model on GrabCAD is loose parts). This turret mill is modelled at about 1:7 (296 mm tall), so it is resized x7 to a Bridgeport's 82 in height and 66 in depth. Specs are typical Series I figures; the model has no maker.
